pages.text: $(italic)"A small piece of Dr. Kacper Darlin"$()$(br2)This record is a physical substance rather than a text: the crystal itself is part of Dr. Darlin's body.$(br2)Of the seven fragments, this is the only one recovered from a defocus product.
pages.title: Fragment: Copper Sulfate Crystal

pages.text: $(bold)Event:$() at some moment, a researcher became copper sulfate.$(br2)$(bold)Collection:$() cause a copper block to drift; it drops with a chance when the break is settled.
